description: Rebuild a reviewed fleet plan from fresh owner-scoped state, then atomically change only eligible paused agents' budget ceilings. Requires the policy version from preview_fleet_reallocation and a stable idempotency key. Never resumes agents, moves or reserves money, funds venues, changes positions, or submits orders.

account_id.description: Optional owned child account UUID. Omit for the active account.

agent_weights.description: Exact reviewed split across every active owned agent, totaling 10000 basis points.

weight_bps.description: Share of deployable headroom in basis points.

expected_policy_version.description: Portfolio mandate version returned by the reviewed preview.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry-safety key for this exact fleet update.

target_deployed_capital_usd.description: Exact reviewed total live-capital target across the fleet.

name: apply_fleet_reallocation
